publication: Reviewed derived TenSet context-ablation summary exports
derivation_notes: CSV line endings are normalized to LF; field values are preserved.
summary.json output_dir is replaced with a relative publication directory; all original numerical values remain unchanged.
audit-summary.json independently checks supplied inventory, aggregate metrics, repeat SDs, paired sign tests, seeded Random order, network endpoint arithmetic and usage totals.
The weighted filter-oracle ceiling is newly derived from supplied per-workload oracle scores and frozen task weights/normalizers; it is a retrospective bound, not a model result.
No local source paths, environment files, credentials, raw candidate configurations, complete rankings or request caches are published.

protocol.json is a compact derivative of the frozen study: model/seed/repeat/pricing settings, phase design, workload counts/weights/normalizers and input/label fingerprints are preserved; absolute paths, candidate ID lists, schedules and rankings are omitted. It is not an executable replacement for study.json.

Markdown and copied SVG trailing whitespace is normalized; the small-comparison PNG is unchanged. The full-comparison PNG/SVG are redrawn from supplied full variant means/SDs and Random-42 network endpoints because the uploaded original clipped both Random reference lines above the y-axis limits. Corrected axes include the Random line and all error bars; original upload hashes remain preserved.
excluded_from_publication: study.json full candidate inventory and private absolute dataset paths
original ZIP archives, source dataset records, prepared shards and collection indexes
raw predictions.jsonl, completion receipts, API request/response caches and credentials
verification_limits: Only the uploaded study and derived summaries/figures were available; no independent raw prediction, receipt, cache or original measurement audit was possible.
Per-workload timing scores and exact Random expectation formulas cannot be independently recomputed from unavailable raw labels.
Three fresh Jev repeats provide a small response-variation sample; SDs are not confidence intervals and exploratory sign tests are unadjusted.
The full phase evaluates only filtered A5 on all 27 ResNet-50 tasks; it is not a full-network seven-condition factorial.
The structural diversity filter differs from the TpuGraphs train-informed largest-tile heuristic.
The paper latency recovery includes the pinned float32 throughput floor; offline network ratios are not physically measured end-to-end timings.
Input-only public-rate estimates exclude output fees, unlogged retries, custom pricing and billing reconciliation.

publication_renderer.correction: Axis limits include both the Random reference and all Jev error bars.
